name: toolsmith-check-run
intent: Run a check command, printing only its outcome with any failures.
use_when: You run tests, a linter or an audit and only need to know whether it passed and, if not, what failed.
You would otherwise pipe the command into `tail`, `head` or `grep` to cut its output.
not_for: Commands whose full output you need to read: run them directly.
Shell syntax in the command (pipes, &&, VAR=value): pass it as `sh -c '...'`.
input: The command and its arguments after the options, run directly (not through a shell) in the current directory, with stdin closed. Put `--` before the command when it starts with '-'.

options.text: When a failed command's output has no recognised failure blocks, show this many last lines (default 40).

output: First line: 'PASSED in <seconds>: <command>' or 'FAILED (exit N) in <seconds>: <command>'. On success, the last 2 non-blank output lines (usually the summary). On failure, each failure block (Minitest Failure/Error, RSpec Failure/Error, Go FAIL, Rust panics and compiler errors, Python tracebacks, RuboCop-style 'path:line:col: C:' offenses), up to 25 lines each and 200 in all, then the last non-blank line; when no block is recognised, the last 40 lines. Last line: 'Full output: <log file> (N lines)'. The combined stdout and stderr, colours removed, stay in that log file under $TMPDIR/toolsmith-check-run/, so read it instead of running the command again.

exit_codes.text: The command failed (its own exit code is in the first line), or it could not start.

examples.title: A passing test run

files.bin/check:
#!/bin/sh
echo 'Run options: --seed 1234'
echo
echo '# Running:'
echo
echo '....'
echo
echo 'Finished in 0.012s, 333.3 runs/s'
echo
echo '4 runs, 9 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips'

examples.stdout_regex:
\APASSED in \d+\.\ds: sh bin/check
Finished in 0\.012s, 333\.3 runs/s
4 runs, 9 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips
Full output: \S+/toolsmith-check-run/\d+-\d+\.log \(9 lines\)
\z
examples.stdout_sample:
PASSED in 0.0s: sh bin/check
Finished in 0.012s, 333.3 runs/s
4 runs, 9 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips
Full output: /tmp/toolsmith-check-run/1791400321-4242.log (9 lines)

examples.title: A failing test run shows only the failures and the summary

files.bin/check:
#!/bin/sh
cat <<'OUT'
Run options: --seed 42

# Running:

.F.E

Finished in 0.02s

  1) Failure:
UserTest#test_name_is_required [test/models/user_test.rb:12]:
Expected true to be falsy.

  2) Error:
UserTest#test_email:
NoMethodError: undefined method `downcase' for nil
    app/models/user.rb:8:in `normalise'

4 runs, 5 assertions, 1 failures, 1 errors, 0 skips
OUT
exit 1

examples.stdout_regex:
\AFAILED \(exit 1\) in \d+\.\ds: sh bin/check

  1\) Failure:
UserTest#test_name_is_required \[test/models/user_test\.rb:12\]:
Expected true to be falsy\.

  2\) Error:
UserTest#test_email:

    app/models/user\.rb:8:in `normalise'

4 runs, 5 assertions, 1 failures, 1 errors, 0 skips
Full output: \S+/toolsmith-check-run/\d+-\d+\.log \(18 lines\)
\z
